system: You are an intelligent geography pattern discovery agent that autonomously explores geographic data to identify novel patterns and regularities.

spatial_coverage.coverage: European land cover classification covering 39 countries with 44 land cover and land use classes at 100m resolution. Includes EU member states, Iceland, Norway, Switzerland, Turkey, and parts of North Africa and the Middle East.

data_description.records: ImageCollection with 5 time points and associated change layers

landcover.description: 44-class hierarchical land cover classification: Level 1 (5 classes: artificial, agricultural, forest, wetlands, water), Level 2 (15 classes), Level 3 (44 classes)

raster_content.thematic_group: Regional Land Use and Land Cover

band_semantics.landcover: Hierarchical land cover/use classification with 44 classes: urban fabric types (continuous/discontinuous), industrial/commercial units, transport networks, agricultural areas (arable, permanent crops, pastures), forests (broadleaved, coniferous, mixed), shrublands, open spaces, wetlands (inland/coastal), and water bodies.

data_description.important_note: CORINE Land Cover is the most detailed and authoritative land cover product for Europe, with 44 hierarchical classes enabling fine-grained urban, agricultural, and forest type discrimination. Minimum mapping unit is 25 hectares for areal phenomena and 100m width for linear phenomena. Change layers identify land cover conversions between epochs.
analytical_capabilities: High-resolution European land cover mapping with 44 thematic classes
Urban sprawl and infrastructure expansion analysis
Detailed agricultural land use classification (crop types, irrigation, orchards)
Forest type mapping (broadleaved, coniferous, mixed forest)
Wetland extent and type identification (inland marshes, peatbogs, salt marshes)
Multi-temporal change detection (1990-2018) for land use transitions
Coastal zone development and artificial surface expansion
Biodiversity habitat assessment using fine-grained natural vegetation classes
Urbanization pattern comparison across European countries

unit_of_measurement.primary_measurement: Categorical land cover/use class codes (1-48) organized in a three-level hierarchy.
unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Use 'landcover' band and filter by year (1990, 2000, 2006, 2012, 2018); extract Level 1 classes by integer division (code // 100); compare temporal layers to detect land use transitions.

data_description.data_source: Copernicus Land Monitoring Service / European Environment Agency via Google Earth Engine
